label: The Morrison sisters, and one explains the towels
from: KATHERINE AND WYNTER FILED AS MARRIED WITH NO SIBLING RELATION RECORDED
note:
The Specter Haven appendix identifies the Morrisons as sisters, and the Archive had read that page without catching it.

KATHERINE RUNS AT STANDARD PLUS HALF. Fifty percent above every other woman on the property, which is the MECHANISM the Archive was missing for a fact it already held: SIR TRASHMUFFIN IS TRAUMATISED BY THEIR TOWELS. They stand upright. They hold a fold. THEY HAVE A CRUNCH. He went into that room once in Arc nine looking for a nest, came out, sat on a staircase for forty minutes and would not let anybody touch him.

WYNTER ALSO CARRIES THE CUM-STUFFED GREMLIN.

FOR SCALE: ON 8 SEPTEMBER IT TOOK THIRTY-TWO WOMEN FINISHING WITHIN NINETY SECONDS OF EACH OTHER to produce one Ghost Haven towel that stood up on its own edge. Those two manage it before breakfast.
